Features

  • EXTREME COMFORT: You always come first with RANGER XP 1000. You’ll appreciate the comfort of a refined interior, plush seats and ample room to enter and exit the vehicle.
  • AMPLE STORAGE: You’ll find more space for you and your gear with 13.5 gallons of built-in interior storage, pre-drilled holes for tie-down D-rings and convenient under-seat storage.
  • IN-CAB ESSENTIALS: Enjoy the storage from dual integrated glove boxes and 6 oversized cup holders. Always be ready to ride with an in-dash charge port for safe and convenient battery charging.
  • ALL-DAY COMFORT: Find your happy place with tilt steering wheel and adjustable, extra-plush seat cushions that deliver comfort from sun-up to sun-down and beyond.
  • RUGGEDLY DURABLE: Built with toughness that lasts well past the honeymoon thanks to improved heavy-duty clutching and 15% stronger chassis and 50% more durable suspension.
  • PERFORMANCE WITH PRECISION: Stay smooth and in control on the job or on the trail with 3-position, user-selectable throttle control with available Performance, Standard and Work modes.
  • NEW 14” ALUMINUM WHEELS: XP 1000’s massive 27" Maxxis tires, combined with bigger, machined-accent wheels give you strength where you need it as well as premium style.
  • MAXIMUM PROTECTION: Tackle tough terrain with confidence at work or play with the class-leading protection of a full-body skid plate and 13” of ground clearance.
  • CAPABILITY AND VERSATILITY: More than just big job capacity, the RANGER XP 1000 makes every task easier with thoughtful innovation and toughness.
  • HALF-TON CAPACITY: Deeper, bigger and stronger, this cargo box lets you make quicker work of big jobs with a class-leading 1,000 lb hauling capability.
  • 5-GALLON BUCKET RINGS: Every detail has been scrutinized to deliver maximum benefit and capability including the perfectly dimensioned cargo box that fits four 5-gallon buckets across in a single row.
  • REINFORCED TIE-DOWN POINTS: You can haul more, more securely with four standard tie-down points to ensure your load stays secure, even in rugged terrain.
